title: Board intelligence
desc: Built a production platform that turns meeting documents and recordings into source-checked briefs, decision timelines and cited Q&A. Led architecture and implementation, with all AI processing kept in the EU.

title: Multilingual news intelligence
desc: Took over an early prototype and developed it with a hired engineer. The portal gathers news in 16 languages, merges coverage of the same event and produces executive briefs, cited answers and a risk register linked to evidence.

title: LabMap
desc: Founded and built a search engine and interactive map of academic labs worldwide. Delivered the full product, from LLM-based data collection and annotation to search, backend and interface; ran promotion and gathered user feedback.

title: Baysor
desc: Lead author and maintainer of Bayesian cell-segmentation software used by labs worldwide. Led the 2026 C++ release: benchmarks showed 2–3× faster segmentation and 10–40% less memory than cpp-0.8.3. Published in Nature Biotechnology.

title: Altos Labs
desc: Analysed single-cell and spatial data for cell-therapy development. Built quality-control metrics and benchmarks measuring the effects of segmentation errors; co-first author of the resulting Nature Genetics paper in 2026.

title: Article Visual Search
desc: Independently built an application for exploring PubMed and Semantic Scholar literature on an interactive map. Combines embeddings, clustering and optional LLM-generated cluster names and summaries. Developed intermittently during 2023–2026.

title: Tentakel
desc: As CTO, hired and managed three developers building LLM applications for businesses. Built a natural-language-to-SQL and visualisation MVP and a RAG product over gigabytes of documents; defined requirements directly with clients.

title: Hausa speech recognition
desc: Built transcription and interview-analysis workflows for Family Empowerment Media through SEADS. Benchmarked Hausa speech-recognition models, fine-tuned Whisper and XLS-R, and published the BibleTTS Hausa dataset on Hugging Face.
